when_to_use: You saw the missed call later and are texting back by hand
text: Hi, this is [Name] from [Business]. Sorry I missed your call earlier. What can I help with? Happy to call back if easier.
notes: Reply the same day if you can

when_to_use: You can offer two call times today
text: Hi, [Name] at [Business] returning your call. I can call you at [2pm] or [4pm] today. Which works, or is text better?
notes: Two specific times are easier to answer than an open question

when_to_use: You were on a job when the call came in
text: Hi, it's [Name] from [Business]. Got your missed call while I was on a job. Reply with what you need and I'll get on it.
notes: If they left a voicemail mention it so they don't repeat themselves

when_to_use: No reply to the first text (send once at most)
text: Hi again from [Business]. Just checking you got the help you needed. Reply anytime if we can still help.

when_to_use: No reply and you have real openings to offer (send once at most)
text: [Business] here. We're holding a few openings [tomorrow]. Want one? Reply YES and we'll confirm.
notes: Only if the openings are real
